v1_scoring_formula.risk_level: CRITICAL if score >= 80; HIGH if >= 60; MEDIUM if >= 30; else LOW
v1_scoring_formula.weights: no separate weights: each detector scales itself to its own cap, so the caps are the weights

delta_definition: delta = ABLATION - FULL. A negative value means removing the detector LOWERED the metric.

rules.contribution_ap: AP(FULL) - AP(variant); positive = the detector helped on this set
rules.removal_reliably_hurts: optimistic paired-bootstrap 95% interval of AP(variant)-AP(FULL) lies entirely below 0
rules.small_change: |AP(variant) - AP(FULL)| < 0.02 (operational label, not a statistical test)
rules.removal_improves_top_of_queue: a positive delta in P@5, P@10, P@20 or Recall@20 even if PR-AUC fell
rules.no_headline_metric_changed: AP, P@5/10/20, Recall@20, detections and adversarial flags at 30/40 all identical to FULL

mandatory_statement: This ablation study evaluates detector contribution on the frozen V2.1 synthetic evaluation set. It does not establish real-world fraud-detection effectiveness.
